note: Short films of Bob, fetched by the Fetch films workflow from films/sources.json. cues maps a beat to a clip: at (seconds into the line), len (how long it holds), from (start point in the clip). v is the take (the start of its Higgsfield job id); change it when a clip is replaced so browsers fetch the new one. Alien Bob takes (Paul's character, 24 October; earlier takes in films/sources.json); black and white; ?films=0 turns them off. card: true shows the line's lettering over the film. then: the film runs straight on into another clip, looped when loop is set, until the reader taps or presses a key, which also moves the story on. wide: a clip's 16:9 take for landscape screens. crop (and focus): crop in by that much about that point (Paul: "on one of the close ups, crop in 40%").
